title: Nonlinear Model Reduction of Complex Networks via Spectral Submanifolds
summary: Complex networked systems are prevalent in biology, engineering, and the social sciences, yet their high-dimensional, nonlinear dynamics pose major challenges for analysis and prediction. A mathematically rigorous route to simplification is to represent system behavior on a low-dimensional, smooth invariant manifold known as a spectral submanifold (SSM). Here we present a comprehensive SSM reduction framework and its globalized extension (gSSM) for dimensionality reduction in large-scale nonlinear networks.
